message.content: {"question":"For all t ∈ R, consider the points P = (1,2,3), Q = (0,0,t), R = (1,-1,t), S = (1,1,t). Which of the following statements is true?","options":{"A":"Points P, Q, R, S are vertices of a parallelogram for all values of t.","B":"Points P, Q, R, S are coplanar for a unique value of t.","C":"Points P, Q, R, S are vertices of a rectangle for all values of t.","D":"Points P, Q, R, S are vertices of a tetrahedron whose volume is |t - 3| for all values of t."},"correct":"B"}
